description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalupedigama, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620006
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and location details) and includes schedules listing land ownership details. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
